criterion:
Manual level-2 verdicts for the fixed-seed sample (level2-sample.json) and their summary.

Criterion: an edge is correct if, whenever the caller executes in this configured build
(OpenSSL, zlib, proxies and websockets on; no HTTP/2, no HTTP/3, no multi-SSL), the receiver
at this call site can hold an object whose field is the target. Caller reachability itself is
not judged (as for direct calls in gold). '?' = not decidable from code reading here.

reasons.cwriter_phase: writer->next is a writer of the same or a later phase (sendf.c cwriter_add); raw is first, chunked is first in transfer-decode and never duplicated, ftp_lc only in FTP
reasons.cf_top_under_hc: b->cf is the chain top beneath HTTPS-CONNECT: SETUP while connecting, then SSL
reasons.no_http3: capsule filter is inserted only under USE_HTTP3 (cf-setup.c), which is off
reasons.recvbuf_never_added: Curl_cf_recvbuf_add has no caller in lib/; placement of a recvbuf filter is unknown
reasons.socket_is_leaf: TCP/UDP/UNIX/TCP-ACCEPT socket filters are chain leaves: cf->next is always NULL here
reasons.generic_dispatch: generic helper over any object of this type in the build
reasons.below_http_proxy: below HTTP-PROXY: h1-proxy (its sub-filter), SSL-PROXY, SOCKS pre-proxy, happy eyeballs, socket
reasons.client_reader: loop stops at the CURL_CR_CLIENT reader: in, buf, null or mime
reasons.single_ssl: CURL_WITH_MULTI_SSL is off: Curl_ssl/ssl_impl is always the OpenSSL backend
